picks.title: Digital Arabic Maqam Archive and open-source MIDI plug-in now available
picks.excerpt: Khyam Allami's long-term research project puts hundreds of Arabic tuning systems, ajnas and maqamat into a free, open archive, paired with a free open-source MIDI plug-in (Tanghim) that lets producers work in microtonal, non-Western tunings directly inside their DAW.
picks.rationale: A free open-source tool a producer can install today to compose in microtonal, non-Western tunings inside any DAW — high actionability and genuine novelty.

picks.title: Talk to Spotify: What AI Chatbots Mean for Music Marketing
picks.excerpt: Spotify's new 'Talk to Spotify' ChatGPT-style assistant replaces passive algorithmic discovery with interactive, prompt-based listening, shifting how artists and marketers must optimise metadata and off-platform SEO to stay discoverable.
picks.rationale: Prompt-based discovery rewrites how releases get found — a direct, tomorrow-relevant shift in how artists and marketers optimise metadata and SEO.

picks.title: Inside LANDR's Fair Trade AI Program for Indie Artists
picks.excerpt: LANDR's Fair Trade AI program pairs upfront cash advances with ongoing revenue sharing when it licenses curated music datasets to AI developers, allocating 25% of net resulting revenue to participating indie artists whose work trains the models.
picks.rationale: A concrete new monetisation route: opt-in dataset licensing with cash advances plus a 25% revenue share — a decision working indie artists can act on now.

picks.title: Lorde Calls Out Spotify's AI 'About the Song' Feature
picks.excerpt: Lorde publicly rejected Spotify's AI-generated 'About the Song' descriptions after the feature surfaced inaccurate context on one of her tracks, arguing that reducing a song to an AI-generated meaning at the source limits free interpretation. Spotify removed the text in question.
picks.rationale: A high-profile artist forcing Spotify to pull auto-generated song context — flags a live risk and precedent any artist should watch as platforms annotate their catalogue.
